declined.reason: These text-side editors (scripts, briefs, research, words) are not an assembly surface, so not-applicable is the likely verdict, but this context shares its directory with Cut.tsx and CutClock.tsx. A fair absence search over _edit/ would hit those siblings, and picking only terms that happen to miss them would be gaming the check. I read the headers of Beats, Script, Scenarios, Words and Research and found no timeline of a cut, so I am declining rather than guessing a state.
